title: Minecraft More Forest
description: Minecraft More Forest is a Vanilla+ mod that makes forests more immersive by adding small natural details like fallen branches, plant fibers, and leaf litter.
body:
Minecraft More Forest is a Vanilla+ style mod that improves and expands forest gameplay while staying close to the original Minecraft experience. It makes forests feel more natural and useful by adding small environmental details such as fallen branches, plant fibers, and leaf litter found on the ground. These resources can be collected and used in simple early-game crafting, giving players more reasons to interact with nature during survival.

The mod also enhances forest generation and atmosphere with subtle visual improvements like natural ground variation and scattered debris under trees. Instead of changing core mechanics or adding complex systems, Minecraft More Forest focuses on small, immersive additions that make exploration feel more rewarding and the world feel more alive, while keeping everything balanced and fully Vanilla-friendly.
